## Observations

- With 250 steps and 64K compaction, `coop --git` passed 8/10. That's the same score and the same two failing pairs as `coop --git` and `coop` at 250 steps with 28K compaction. Compared with `solo` at the same per-agent budget (250 steps, 64K, 7/10), the two runs disagree only on `dspy_task/8394`. Agents compacted far less than at 28K (median 3 per agent, range 1 to 17), and 19 of 20 agents submitted before step 250.
- `pallets_jinja_task/1559`: agent1 (feature 4) submitted a 242-line patch, the first real submission on this pair in any run. Agent2 (feature 8) spent 70 minutes stuck on a test command that never finished (it was stopped by hand), then hit step 250 with a 1-line patch that failed to apply. When one patch doesn't apply, the grader tests only agent1's patch against both features' tests, so the pair failed.
- `pillow_task/290`: both agents submitted and the patches merged cleanly, but feature 4 failed 1 of its 8 tests while feature 5 passed all 9. This matches `coop` at 250 steps with 28K compaction.
- Running 2 pairs at a time (4 agents) peaked at 1,199,223 input tokens/min, with 6 `429` and 3 `5xx` retries and no agent errors. Wall time was 242 minutes, including the 70-minute stuck command.
